summary:
Checked all 20 estimates against the paper after reading all 522 markdown lines, including references, back matter and the appended Reporting Summary. Extracted the text of all 12 PDF pages and recovered Table 1 with pymupdf.find_tables(). All 231 numeric occurrences mapped by sources match their quotes and belong to the stated outcomes and contrasts. All 59 source quotes are supported: 50 match the cited page text and nine match the selected recovered table cells. Counts were checked against Methods, with raters and model-only responses kept separate from participants. The six problems are coding corrections: two se_basis fields and four combined-arm labels.

All 25 supplied mechanical flags are false positives. The 16 p-values are correct numerical representations of the printed scientific notation, including the greater precision in Table 1 for Experiments 3 and 4. The nine flagged Table 1 quotes copy the row labels and selected cells; find_tables() places the t-test degrees of freedom after the statistic, whereas ordinary page text attaches them to t. The quotes are therefore supported despite failing a contiguous page-text search. No numeric repair is needed.

The remaining requested outcome codes and count fields are supported. The four factorial cell contrasts compare complete randomized arms and can be retained; their two-arm counts are unprinted and correctly null. The paper's separately labelled technology main-effect tests in Experiments 4 and 5 do not establish distinct marginal contrasts beyond the already flagged conditional-test ambiguity, so no additional pooled estimate is asserted. The qualitative top-ranked-share record is supported; the omitted newness categories lack an identifiable eligible contrast in the supplied PDF. Other outcomes without printed contrasts and the excluded self-reports, mediation parameters and model-only comparisons are documented in not_extracted. No further eligible contrast could be confirmed from this document.

The separate Supplementary Notes were not available in the searched local literature and repository PDF folders. Requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named OSF project API and then the publisher both failed with WinError 10013 (socket access denied). Completeness beyond the supplied PDF and its appended Reporting Summary therefore remains unverified.
